correctness.rationale: Use the Hilbert–Schmidt and standard data norms. On the unit basis W_{u,v}/p the measurement columns are distinct phase-space characters times the ambiguity coefficients divided by p. There are p^4 data coordinates, so the column norms are p times the absolute ambiguity. Translating the cubic gives 3h(t−h/2)²+h³/4=k for h≠0 and empty intersections for h=0,k≠0. Among the p choices of k for each h≠0 there are (p−1)/2 empty, one single, and (p−1)/2 double intersections. One or two p-th roots cannot cancel. For u=0 the cyclotomic polynomial makes vanishing equivalent to permutation of the p cubic-linear values. If both coefficients are nonzero, collisions are off-diagonal points of t²+tw+w²=−a/b: a nonzero level has p−χ(−3) points (split quadratic form or nonzero norm fiber), at most two diagonal. Hence exactly the two stated axis tests give zeros. At (a,b)=(0,0) the sum is p. For each double intersection the nonzero linear difference v·(x₁−x₂) is uniform, giving the two-root cosine multiset and the stated multiplicities. This gives precisely the rank, full Weyl kernel and all singular values with the identity block left as cubic sums. No pure-state inference is needed.
residual_risks: Fresh direct matrix SVD at p=5 and quotient-character diagonalization of an explicitly constructed Gram row at p=7 reproduced ranks 317 and 1219 and both full singular-value multisets, to tolerance 10⁻⁶. These finite numerical checks do not certify general primes. The frozen checker tests phase-difference uniformity for one representative double shift per prime (lines 69–78), not independently for every double shift as its prose suggests; the uniformity for all follows from the proof.

evidence: Goldberger–Kang–Okoudjou §2 gives Gram eigenvalues d|A|² and rank from nonzero correlations for a cyclic system. The same-day 1f76e4a64221 proof step 1 gives the elementary abelian Weyl character reduction without depending on the graph exponent.
broader_coverage.reasoning: The Goldberger et al. formulation is not literally over F_p² but the character argument is unchanged for this group: diagonal conjugation by all Weyl shifts produces mutually orthogonal character columns. Pure-state PhaseLift criteria for small Hermitian matrix rank are a different question. No chronological conclusion is drawn from the quartic record's date.

claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: The discriminant h²−4ab=(4k−h³)/(3h) is 4 times the assigned s, so counting its square classes already fixes each intersection and its population. At a nonempty shift there are at most two roots of unity; these cannot cancel. For two points, the difference of their phases runs over each residue p times, which by |1+ζ^j| gives the cosine bands without any remaining cubic computation. At the identity shift, the standard character formula retains the exponential sums and the preceding exact classification supplies all zeros. The target combines these facts but resolves no additional nontrivial cubic fiber or spectral class.

originality.rationale: No identical standalone cubic Gabor rank statement was found, and the same-day quartic record is not equivalent. Nevertheless the exact cubic result, not merely the methods, is directly determined by the earlier catalogue results on this same cubic: the Oct. 4 pair-sum fiber description gives every translated support by central symmetry of the graph, while the Oct. 11 low-frequency criterion is exactly the full zero-translation block. Standard Gabor character diagonalization and elementary one-/two-point Fourier transforms then give all the claimed rank, kernel and bands. Neither the extension norm as a scalar nor the whole prime-square spectrum-classification theorem is being identified with operator rank. The overlap is at the level of the explicit supporting local formulas, and the failure is for mechanical implication, not proof of an earlier verbatim publication or a claim about same-day priority.
residual_risks: The comparison establishes implication, not an earlier identical publication or provenance of the calculation. Unindexed exact statements would not change this distinction.

value.rationale: The operator rank and translated spectrum are natural invariants, and distinguishing full linear tomography from pure-state recovery is useful. But here the exact invariants reduce mechanically to already resolved cubic two-point fibers and the exact prior frequency zeros on the same graph; the remaining multiplicities are those of a nonzero linear functional and the universal transform of a two-point support. No further cubic exponential-sum magnitude, structural obstruction, or new spectral regime is resolved beyond that recomposition. This does not meet the scientific-value bar for an exact invariant that is already mechanically implied.
residual_risks: An independently useful classification of nonzero identity-block magnitudes or a theorem beyond these mechanically determined values would be a different claim.
